response.justification: Bogdan brings well over the required 8 years of software development experience and a genuinely strong developer-tooling profile — a D-language test runner, an assertion library, CI/CD and GitLab infrastructure work, Selenium curriculum development, and TDD/trunk-based-development advocacy — which maps closely to the engineering productivity focus. However, the resume shows no evidence of formal people management: no direct reports, no hiring, performance management, or one-on-one ownership, which is a hard minimum (2 years) for this Level II Manager role. Technical leadership is implied by Staff titles, founding GISCollective, and running workshops, but is not explicitly framed as leading a team toward a roadmap. He would be a compelling senior/staff IC or tech lead candidate; as a manager hire he is a stretch unless a screening call surfaces unlisted leadership scope.
strengths: Deep developer-tools and test-infrastructure portfolio (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, Selenium)
15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded
Proven knowledge-sharing and mentoring via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: No demonstrated people management or direct-report experience
Limited evidence of roadmap ownership or organizational-change leadership
Mobile-platform exposure is dated and secondary (iOS/tvOS circa 2015)

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test automation depth
